facts.business: Lyons Corporate Market Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India, engaged in providing loans and making investments in shares and securities within India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is cautiously optimistic in its outlook for the year 2025-2026.

key_risks: Competition from banks and rising interest rate scenario
Performance closely linked with overall Indian economy, financial and capital markets
Volatility in capital and financial markets
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not entered into any contract or arrangement with related parties referred in section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 during the year under review. However, related party transactions with KMPs for remuneration and sitting fees are disclosed in Note 22(a).
